reports.title: Blackstone Digital Infrastructure Trust Reports Third-Quarter 2026 Results

desk.headline: EPS of $0.15 beats in first full quarter after IPO; first deal is a $5bn Amazon data center sale-leaseback; no guidance

other.label: Net income
other.change: first full quarter since May 2026 IPO

results: Net income was $15.6m, or $0.15 a share, in the first full quarter since the May 2026 listing.
FFO was also $0.15 a share and AFFO $0.17, with no property owned yet during the quarter.
Agreed its first deal: a 75.1% stake in 13 new data centers on two campuses, sold and leased back by Amazon.
The $5.0bn portfolio has a 7.0% starting yield, 2.75% yearly rent increases and a 12-year initial triple-net lease.

guidance.summary: The company gives no earnings or dividend guidance in this release.

points: BXDC's $3.7bn share of the deal is to be funded with about $1.9bn cash and about $1.9bn of debt.
Leverage of about 49% at closing is above the 40% long-term target; future deals are meant to bring it down.
The deal should give a starting AFFO yield in the low-to-mid 5% range; closing is expected before year-end.
A special Q4 dividend may be paid to meet REIT rules; management said it is not a run-rate payout.
Hyperscaler sale-leasebacks are seen roughly doubling the market BXDC can invest in.
call.source: Q3 2026 call transcript — The Motley Fool, 16 Nov 2026

watch: Closing of the Amazon deal and the final debt cost.
Size of any special Q4 dividend and the first regular payout after closing.
Further deals that lower leverage toward the 40% target.
